china_opportunities.value: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. R ecruit Masters, Nurture New Talent : As you rise to prominence, legendary producers might appear, offering guidance, tasks, or even a chance to recruit them! At the same time, nurture your employees—they have dreams too, and one day, a star from your company might become your strongest rival. Define Your Path, Evolve Your Tech : Our unique tech tree system represents not just technological advancement, but the evolution of your company's strategy, culture, and business model. Will you become an "Artisan Workshop" focused on refined games, or a "Tech Titan" leading industry trends? The future is shaped by every R&D choice you make. III. Transcend Gaming: Become a Cultural Icon When your works become classics and your company is hailed as legendary, your influence will extend far beyond the gaming industry. You will become a cultural symbol defining the next era. Cross-media Expansion, Build an IP Empire : Lead the film and TV adaptation of your legendary titles, collaborating with top directors to create box office hits. License or build physical theme parks based on your game worlds, turning them into pilgrimage sites for fans globally. Elevate Value, Impact Society : Partner with universities and medical institutions to develop serious educational games or therapeutic experiences. Use the power of games to create profound social value and earn respect that goes beyond commerce. Every path can lead to your own version of Rome. input.china_demand: Step into the explosive fury of war with Hell Let Loose: Vietnam. Play a decisive role in one of the most iconic conflicts in history with expansive 50v50 player battles, where teamwork, tactics and an arsenal of destructive weapons combine to shape the battlefield in your favour. UNLEASH HELL IN THE JUNGLE Enter the explosive conflict of the Vietnam War and fight your way through some of the fiercest clashes in modern history. Join the battle raging across an extreme landscape of vast mountain gorges and thick jungle, where the North Vietnamese Armies clash with the military strength of the US Armed Forces. Build tunnels, fly helicopters, drive patrol boats, use historically accurate weapons and work with your team to achieve victory. OWN THE BATTLE Take the battle to the enemy across 6 large-scale maps inspired by real world locations. Play as either the North Vietnamese Army or US Armed Forces and choose from one of 17 specialised roles within a 50-strong team made up of multiple squads. Join or lead infantry, recon, armour, mortar squads and helicopter units, using communication and teamwork with your fellow players to identify objectives and ruthlessly exploit your opponent’s weaknesses. Emergent gameplay features bring intensity and realism to the conflict, as players tackle each battle with authentic weapons, orders and tactics. Follow the chain of command and work together as a team to meet your objectives and achieve victory. DEPLOY YOUR FORCES In the heat and fury of the Vietnam War, the battle is more dynamic than ever. New US aerial units feature fully operational helicopters for fire support and supply drops. NVA forces can build extensive tunnel networks to gain the upper hand with surprise attacks. Both sides can hunt the enemy through Vietnam’s complex river network with heavily armed patrol boats built and launched to seek and destroy. Enhanced player movement, including swimming, climbing and fast crawling, and interactions such as dragging co-combatants away from active fire to give them a chance to heal and re-engage, all adds to the immersive battle experience. Your goal is to provide customers with unforgettable experiences every time they visit. You are recruited by a gang member who initially planned for a money-laundering operation. However, as an ambitious manager, you see the potential for this bakery to thrive. Explore the neighborhood after the store closes: talk to neighbors and customers, assist them, and unlock their stories. You might find yourself deeply involved with the community and falling in love with this charming little bakery. input.china_demand: A pausable real-time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines. “The truth is... less than 1% of war is real fighting. The other 99% is just suffering in the trenches — from shellfire, hunger, disease, and rats.” — An unnamed soldier Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a tactical survival and outpost simulation management game driven by various unexpected events on the battlefield. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. You can personally name each operation — yes, you are also a part of history. Visual Design In addition to gameplay design, Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare has gone to great lengths to enhance immersion through its visual design. Unit Icons The game's unit icons are based on real-world NATO military symbols. When a unit's equipment changes, the icon automatically updates to reflect its current configuration, accurately representing real-world military notation. You can freely customize different unit types to your liking. (Example: When a recon squad boards a pickup truck, its unit icon will change to that of a motorized recon squad.) Destructible Structures In Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare , buildings are composed of modular rooms that react dynamically to player actions. This means destruction is never the same—no two buildings will (probably...) collapse in exactly the same way. Program Design Multithreaded Optimization of the Pathfinding System You will experience Establish frontline outposts to store supplies and manpower arriving from the rear. Scavenge materials in the ruins of abandoned towns, and transform existing buildings into various military and logistics facilities. Assign soldiers to logistics positions, adjust work priorities and shifts, and automate the operation of the frontline outposts. Form various combat teams to construct your own combat system. Take building clusters as tactical points, relying on solid building cover to engage in tug-of-war battles with the enemy. Arrange logistics and transportation to ensure sufficient supplies to frontline positions. Evacuate the wounded — the faster they receive treatment, the more likely they are to survive. Call for off-field artillery or airstrike support to lay the foundation for infantry assaults. Clean the battlefield and collect spoils; recover the bodies of comrades — we leave no one behind! Recover enemy armament— you may choose to repair and reuse it. Take over special locations in the city (hospitals, factories, etc.) to enhance your logistics base with existing equipment. Adjust food rations to quickly restore morale after large battles. Gather ingredients locally and grow vegetables on wasteland to ensure balanced nutrition for your soldiers. Dig trenches and stockpile supplies to prepare for enemy counterattacks. Maintain your armament to ensure it won't fail in the next battle. input.china_demand: Frenetic action and LCD aesthetic! In this 2D Shoot 'Em Up, switch between a robot hero and his benign tumor to stop a bizarre cult. You have 8 hours to save humanity's memory: defeat grotesque bosses, ride the skies on your Future Board, and master the chaos in a retro-futuristic Tokyo. Future Knight is a 2D action Shoot 'Em Up that fuses the nostalgia of LCD screens with the brutality of modern combat. Imagine your old handheld console coming to life, but with a bizarre story, frantic combat, and a unique visual aesthetic inspired by classic electronic handheld games. 8 HOURS TO THE END OF THE WORLD It is May 23rd, 1993. The Lady of the Past, leader of the "Present" pyramid scheme cult, has just washed her underwear and, incidentally, wiped the brains of all humanity. Only you, a robot built over 30 years from the remains of a 90s soap opera actor, can stop her. But you are not alone. You have Two More , a benign tumor—inexplicably powerful and with a life of its own—living inside you. Your mission is to travel to the past, exactly 8 hours before the apocalypse. Each level (Biome) represents one hour in this lady's schedule before she wipes our memories. You will have to sabotage her day: from her walk in the park to her meal at an all-you-can-eat buffet... The clock is ticking, Future Knight. Can you save the future before it becomes the past? THE LETHAL DANCE: SWITCH AND DESTROY The key to Future Knight is Synergy. "Alone you go fast, together you go further." Future Knight (The Muscle): Fire your quantum plasma Techno Blaster, deliver lethal bites, roll to dodge, and unleash chaos with heavy weaponry. Two More (The Agility): Eject your partner! Use him to perform lethal Super Dashes, climb walls with his natural viscosity, fire at short range, and squeeze into tight spots. Choreography of Violence: Switch between both characters instantly. Recover Future Knight's health by using Two More, and recharge Two More's energy by using Future Knight. Create a deadly dance to annihilate your enemies with style. BIZARRE "NEO-RETRO" AESTHETIC The game takes place inside the technology of a calculator and a liquid crystal display. We have created an unsettling aesthetic that blends the adorable with the grotesque, inspired by the works of Satoshi Kon and Japanese weirdness. Everything you see is ink blots moving... but we assure you, you've never seen ink move like this. KEY FEATURES A Race Against Time: 8 hours, 8 biomes, one destination. Beat levels that alternate between horizontal and vertical scrolling with crazy physics. From dangerous construction sites to deadly sushi conveyor belts, every level is a critical hour before the mass memory wipe. Combat Synergy: Shooting isn't enough; you have to dance. Instantly switch between Future Knight's brute force and Two More's slimy agility to create lethal choreographies. Master their differences and collect the mysterious sectarian triangles , the only key capable of unlocking the path to the truth. "Liquid Crystal" Pixel Art: A unique art direction where LCD nostalgia comes to life. input.china_demand: You're a security officer deep within Area 51. Scan the staff, verify clearances, and decide who can enter the elevator and who absolutely mustn't leave. The deeper you go, the less certain you are that anyone standing before you is still human. A "SIMPLE" JOB Security 51 is an atmospheric horror security guard simulator inspired by Papers, Please, and SCP paranoia. You're on duty in the underground bunker of Area 51, where the most dangerous part begins at the elevator: the shaft descends for miles down to unknown levels. Whether it's laboratories, anomalies, inhumane experiments, or something alien—you're not supposed to know. Your task is simple: let in those who have access and stop those who don't... even if everything looks "right" on the surface. SECURE, CONTAIN, PROTECT Everyone who passes through your checkpoint carries papers, passes, or verbal orders. Your job is to check names, positions, clearance levels, and time, ensuring the number of people entering and leaving matches, and pay attention to any oddities. These could be incorrect answers, behavior that deviates from protocol, slurred speech, or even documents that seem too perfect. As time passes you'll catch yourself thinking that something's wrong more and more, and the only thing to rely on will be the protocols. But even they can be wrong. TOTAL CONTROL With experience, you'll gain increasingly more accurate methods of identity verification, such as fingerprint verification or blood testing. Did that janitor simply open the wrong door, or are they a spy for an enemy government? Or are they not even human? When in doubt, quarantine the suspect. Sometimes you'll make mistakes and lock up an ordinary employee, and sometimes you'll find a titanium cell ripped open from the inside. Some decisions will have immediate consequences, others only after several shifts. CONTAIN THE THREAT The consequences of every mistake go far beyond issues in the workplace. Let the wrong person out, and the infection will ravage the city. Isolate suspicious employees, investigate anomalies, and launch new operations to contain the threat before it's too late. Remember, it's not just about who you let in, but who or what you let out into the world. input.china_demand: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you… A deadly virus has broken out, and the town is swarming with zombies. Police partners, Olivenia and Noah, receive a mission to escort a Special Agent to a secret base. Noah guides her from the computer room while Olivenia fights the zombies on her own. Along the way, she uncovers information about another survivor, Beatrice, as well as a mysterious biological weapon. Will Olivenia be able to find Beatrice and survive the zombie outbreak? Or will she have a one-sided dance with the enemies while Noah may or may not be listening in the background? Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined is a rogue-lite exploration RPG/ADV set in a city infected by a zombie virus. It combines action and strategy in a fusion of intense gunplay with turn-based combat, item crafting, and a deep skill system. Each bullet shot, each grenade thrown, and each step taken will count towards failure or success. Rogue-lite progression Strengthen yourself by unlocking new skills after each mission. Buy new guns, upgrades, and useful items. Get stronger and defeat the enemies! Unique enemies and boss battles Dozens of strange abominations can be encountered; from zombies to mutated creatures, infested animals, living plants, weaponized machinery, and many more. Every stage features a unique selection of enemies, complete with a boss battle at the end. Defeating a stage boss will require clever use of strategy, learning the enemies' weaknesses, and utilizing the right skills at the right time. Crafting System Unlock crafting to combine items into new or stronger ones. Recovery items and ammunition for a secret weapon can be assembled whenever you are not in an active battle. Plan ahead of time to make sure you have the edge in combat when you need it the most. Encounter random events: every run is different Meet other characters, open chests with valuable loot, buy stat-altering drinks, and defeat thieving little rodents among many other events that can be encountered at random. No two runs will be the same. Utilize an arsenal of weapons and skills Unlock unique guns, each with their own benefits and downsides; use throwables to blast enemies into pieces, blind them, stun them or set them all on fire. Olivenia can also learn hundreds of different active and passive skills. Every gun has its own set of active skills, like unlocking the potential of rapid fire for the pistol, or birdshot to hit all enemies at once with the shotgun, supplemented by a huge number of passives that boost your defenses. Worlds of endless strategy and grand ambitions. In Eon Empires , you can lead your own nation through war, expansion, and intrigue, balancing your nation’s needs against the moves of your rivals. Resources, alliances, outsmarting enemies on a path of global supremacy. Explore Every Era – and Beyond : Journey through all historical eras – ancient, medieval, and modern times, then shape the future with futuristic technologies or explore alternative paths, inspired by steampunk, cyberpunk, and other hypothetical worlds. Dynamic Consequences : Face surprising events triggered by your past decisions. Every choice can have ripple effects. Multiple Paths to Power : Develop your empire in countless ways – industrialize your economy, build a mighty military, master diplomacy, dominate trade, conduct espionage operations, shape religion and culture, or push the boundaries of science. Warfare Across All Fronts : Engage in battles on land, sea, and in the air. From traditional armies to nuclear weapons, cyberattacks, and futuristic superweapons, strategy and tactics will determine your victory. Manage Your Empire : Control dissent, maintain economic stability, oversee public health, and steer your population toward prosperity... or into chaos. Endless Replayability : Play on fully customizable or randomly generated maps with many settings. No two games are ever the same! Eon Empires includes : over 190 buildings , like fortifications, temples, and power plants over 70 military units , like ballistae and bombers over 90 decisions, internal and political, like trade, subversion, or launching nukes over 70 cultural legacies , like seasonal rites or humanism Empires rise and fall. china_opportunities.value: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, control the finances and build a winning organisation from the boardroom. Features of version 0.1. 2 Countries available (Spain and England) 6 Divisions (4 from England and 2 from Spain) More than 6,000 players More than 1,500 staff members More than 100 sponsors 8 facilities to upgrade or build Club vision system where you decide which club philosophy to follow. FD 27 — Your club. Your company. Your legacy. Football isn't won only on the pitch. Behind every champion team there is a director who made the right decisions: the signing nobody saw coming, the coach who changed the dressing room's mentality, the sponsor who allowed building a competitive squad. In FD 27 you don't sit on the bench, you sit in the office. You are the owner, the CEO, the person who decides the direction of the club from the ground up. Here you don't choose formations or give tactical instructions. Here you decide who does it for you. Every season is a management test. You have a limited budget, a squad that needs reinforcements, a coaching staff that may not be up to the task, and fans demanding results. Your job is to build a structure that works: find the right coach, surround him with the right team, and give him the players he needs to compete. If you do it well, results will come. If not, the consequences will be yours. A club is a company, and you run it FD 27 reproduces the real structure of a professional football club. You don't just manage a squad of players, you manage a complete organization with four departments that need to work as one gear: Sporting Direction, Medical Department, Marketing, and Financial Department. Each department is made up of staff members with their own attributes, performance, and salary. You decide who to hire, who to fire, and how much you are willing to pay for the talent you need. china_opportunities.value: A tactical, map-based WWII submarine sim set in the Pacific Theater: Approach, intercept, strike unseen, withdraw into the deep. With realistic instruments, a Torpedo Data Computer (TDC), and including a full campaign with missions, patrol zones, radio intel, and more. Silent Shark is a tactical and realism-focused WWII submarine simulator built around plotting, estimation, and submarine command, set in the Pacific Theater. Track contacts by hydrophone, work out their course and speed, identify ships through the periscope, estimate range with a stadimeter, and build your firing solution from imperfect information. The game is played on a tactical chart with period-inspired instruments and deliberate controls. A good attack takes preparation. You need to approach from the right angle, manage depth and speed, account for visibility and sea state, set up the torpedoes, and leave yourself a way out before escorts respond. If destroyers do locate you, be prepared for evasive maneuvers and paying attention when to go hard and fast, or slow and silent. Core Features Map tools like compass, ruler, timestamped points, and angles help you to hunt for the perfect course to intercept. Realistic replicas of historical instruments such as the engine telegraph, depth meter, and stopwatch. Periscope with 1.5x and 6x zoom shows a stylized 3D view of contacts within visibility range. Hydrophone for tracking ships and convoys by sound - tell the difference between freighters and escort by pitch. Manual range estimation of ships with a fully functional stadimeter: identify the ship to get its mast height, then auto-calculate the distance by observing the angle to the top of the mast. Torpedo Data Computer (TDC) with a Position Keeper: Enter angle-on-bow, target speed, target bearing, and target distance to fire torpedoes that will hit their targets. Torpedo tube flooding, gyro angle, spread, and salvo control with a torpedo firing box modeled after the real thing. Sea state, weather, time-of-day, all have a significant effect on visibility and stealth Dynamic thermal layers based on time of day and region, measured by bathythermographic readings Destroyer escorts, aircraft, merchant traffic, and convoy encounters. Destroyers act on their own predictions of your location based on a realistic sonar model and their own hydrophone readings. Tutorials, standalone scenarios, and a scenario editor Dynamic music based on Holst's Planets. Full Campaign Pacific Theater patrol campaign with assigned patrol zones and long-range mission planning Radio intelligence updates providing situational awareness and contact hints Historical events affecting strategy, including early-war base losses in Manila and Sumatra Progression system featuring 6 submarines, from Porpoise-class to Balao-class Resource management across extended war patrols, including fuel, torpedoes, and crew endurance Dynamic base operations with relocation as the war progresses Aircraft threat management requiring careful dive timing and surface discipline Evolving enemy presence with changing convoy routes, escort strength, and patrol density Persistent campaign outcomes shaped by player success, losses, and survival Long-term survival challenge: navigate the full duration of the Pacific war campaign Cribbage mini-game for some variety on long patrols. Silent Shark is designed for players who like naval history, tactical simulations, manual targeting, and games where the interesting part is keeping a clear head despite incomplete information. Torpedo Data Computer (TDC) with a Position Keeper: Enter angle-on-bow, target speed, target bearing, and target distance to fire torpedoes that will hit their targets. Torpedo tube flooding, gyro angle, spread, and salvo control with a torpedo firing box modeled after the real thing. Sea state, weather, time-of-day, all have a significant effect on visibility and stealth Dynamic thermal layers based on time of day and region, measured by bathythermographic readings Destroyer escorts, aircraft, merchant traffic, and convoy encounters. Destroyers act on their own predictions of your location based on a realistic sonar model and their own hydrophone readings. Tutorials, standalone scenarios, and a scenario editor Dynamic music based on Holst's Planets. Full Campaign Pacific Theater patrol campaign with assigned patrol zones and long-range mission planning Radio intelligence updates providing situational awareness and contact hints Historical events affecting strategy, including early-war base losses in Manila and Sumatra Progression system featuring 6 submarines, from Porpoise-class to Balao-class Resource management across extended war patrols, including fuel, torpedoes, and crew endurance Dynamic base operations with relocation as the war progresses Aircraft threat management requiring careful dive timing and surface discipline Evolving enemy presence with changing convoy routes, escort strength, and patrol density Persistent campaign outcomes shaped by player success, losses, and survival Long-term survival challenge: navigate the full duration of the Pacific war campaign Cribbage mini-game for some variety on long patrols. Silent Shark is designed for players who like naval history, tactical simulations, manual targeting, and games where the interesting part is keeping a clear head despite incomplete information. The Developer Silent Shark was created with lots of love by John Goering - indie developer from Berlin. John is the creator of the head tracking app SmoothTrack and the thought organizing app Mindscope. He thinks it's a bit strange to talk about himself in the third person, but doesn't really know how else to write this section. He grew up playing the sub sim Silent Service II on Atari, then later discovered Silent Hunter IV, and more recently, UBoat - he then decided to take the parts he loved most about these games - the map mode - and double down on that and turn it into the sub sim of his own dreams. No driving required—step behind the scenes as the boss to tune cars, manage drivers, and experience the pure joy of motorsport management!" nfinite R: Idle Racing is a racing idle management game tailor-made for car enthusiasts and those who love to sneak in a little gaming while working. Here, you don't need to tense up and focus on hitting the perfect racing line. Instead, you step into the shoes of a team's gold-medal tuner and mod shop boss. The game perfectly supports [Desktop Idling] during work hours, with an adaptive window that sits comfortably at the bottom of your screen. While you are typing code, writing reports, or browsing the web, your exclusive ride is automatically speeding along the edge of your screen with its engine roaring—continuously generating income for you without ever delaying your actual work. Say goodbye to the heavy grind and tense nerves! No stressful inputs are required. Check in occasionally, click a few times when you're free, and just enjoy the fun of the game. Development Plan Tuning & Simulation Management Start from a dilapidated garage and a beat-up old street racer, and gradually revive your custom car empire. Say goodbye to tedious stat crunching; the game offers the pure soul of car modification. Unlock more modification kits as you level up, which not only drastically boosts your car's performance but also evolves its badass appearance. Hire and manage workshop employees to build an efficient and lightning-fast workflow! Intense Idle Racing The cars drive fully automatically on idle throughout the race, never demanding your core focus. During your breaks, you can choose to actively intervene—by training racers, unleashing exclusive skills at critical moments, and pulling off extreme overtakes. Instantly take control of the race's pacing and use your strategy to significantly boost your win rate and tournament earnings. Deep Modification System Satisfy your ultimate craving for machinery and speed! Dive deep into your vehicle's powertrain and chassis tuning, from engine enhancements to transmission system upgrades. Not only are there hardcore internal performance boosts, but there is also a massive variety of widebody kits, custom spoilers, and personalized wheels for you to mix and match. Every meticulous tweak allows your race car to show off a truly unique stance on the track. Collect More Vehicles As your garage continues to expand, you will have the opportunity to unlock and collect a massive roster of classic race cars across different styles. Continuously enrich your garage collection, assign the most suitable cars to compete based on specific track requirements and personal preferences, and watch them roar past on your secondary screen. Rich Character System Recruit and train highly talented racers and tuning shop mechanics. Every driver has an exclusive driving style and unique skills that can save the day on the track; meanwhile, excellent workshop staff and operations specialists can massively improve prep efficiency and offline income. Strategically balance your team lineup to keep your crew running like a well-oiled machine. Dynamic Weather System Your racing journey will never be monotonous. The game introduces a rich, dynamic weather system. Whether it's a crystal-clear street or a neon-lit rainy night, the game delivers completely different visual atmospheres, making every idle lap feel immersive and fresh. input.china_demand: A cozy pixel-art restaurant sim. Take over a failing diner, master 30 recipes, manage unique staff, use 40 tools, unlock 30 secrets. 10 festivals bring challenges, 10 endings await. Easy to pick up, surprisingly deep — build your million-dollar dream! Welcome to your dream restaurant! This is a warm, pixel-art restaurant management sim where you don't just cook — you build a culinary empire from a struggling street stall to a million-dollar hotspot . Massive Content, Endless Possibilities 30 Signature Recipes : From humble fried rice and braised pork to exquisite French escargot and A5 Wagyu. Curate your menu to define your restaurant's identity and destiny. Dozens of Chefs & Waiters : Each staff member has unique traits and personalities. Hire seasoned veterans or nurture young talent — team composition is a strategic puzzle. 40 Functional Tools : From "Smart Woks" that speed up cooking to "Influencer Signage" that boosts foot traffic. Use them wisely to turn the tide in critical moments. 30 Business Secrets : Unlock strategies like "Hunger Marketing," "Cost Crunch," and "Michelin Star Hunt." Each secret reshapes the rules and opens fresh playstyles. A Living, Breathing World 10 Festivals & Events : Lunar New Year, Mid-Autumn Festival, Food Carnival, Halloween… Each brings unique crowds and special challenges. Seize the seasonal opportunities to maximize profits. 10 Unique Endings : Every decision alters your restaurant's fate. Will you become the neighborhood's beloved "comfort food haven," a "three-Michelin-star" fine dining icon, or… go bankrupt again? Ten endings await your discovery. Easy to Learn, Deep to Master No tedious tutorials — drag-and-drop controls and intuitive feedback get you cooking in under five minutes. But reaching that million-dollar goal requires balancing costs, staffing, reputation, and R&D — every decision tests your business acumen. Cozy Pixel Art, Warm Aesthetics Delicate pixel visuals with warm, bright palettes, paired with a relaxing soundtrack — even in the busiest rushes, you'll feel the heartwarming charm of everyday life. Whether you're a casual player or a sim enthusiast , there's a flavor for everyone. So tie on your apron, grab your spatula — your million-dollar journey begins with one plate of fried rice! Experience the journey of a content creator from obscurity to industry leadership! 关于这款游戏 从一名默默无闻的创作者开始，打造属于你的内容帝国。 《流量时代（Creator Era）》是一款像素风模拟经营游戏。 从零开始，你将踏入内容创作行业，选择属于自己的发展方向，拍摄视频、积累粉丝、打造爆款内容，与品牌合作、直播带货、组建团队，最终建立属于自己的传媒公司，成为影响千万人的顶级创作者。 每一次选题、每一次发布、每一次商业决策，都将改变你的创作生涯。 你，能否成为下一个时代传奇？ 🎥 从零开始创作 从一间小房间、一张桌子、一台电脑开始。 选择视频题材，策划内容，拍摄、剪辑、发布。 不同的内容方向拥有不同的发展路线。 数码 游戏 科技 汽车 美食 动画 搞笑 知识科普 Vlog 摄影 旅行 健身 美妆 宠物 音乐 更多创作领域…… 寻找热点，把握趋势，制作真正能够爆火的视频。 📈 数据决定一切 每一条视频都会实时产生数据。 观察你的： 播放量 点赞 收藏 评论 弹幕 转发 粉丝增长 热度趋势 收益变化 研究数据，调整创作方向，打造属于自己的爆款公式。 🤝 接受商业合作 不同产品拥有不同利润、销量和用户评价。 真正优秀的创作者，不只是拥有播放量，更拥有商业价值。 🏢 建立你的创作公司 一个人终究精力有限。 招聘员工。 扩大办公室。 建立专业团队。 组建属于自己的传媒公司。 招聘： 策划 摄影 剪辑 特效 运营 商务 人事 财务 法务 合理分配员工能力，提高团队效率。 🏠 不断升级工作环境 从出租屋开始。 逐渐升级你的创作空间。 小工作室 创意办公室 多人团队 专业摄影棚 大型传媒公司 更好的设备意味着更高的创作效率。 🏆 收集属于你的荣誉 不断突破自己的纪录。 获得各种平台荣誉。 例如： 十万粉丝 百万粉丝奖牌 千万粉丝奖牌 百大创作者 年度创作者 热门视频 最佳商业合作 年度影响力人物 成为全平台最受欢迎的创作者。 📊 管理你的事业 除了创作，你还需要经营公司。 管理： 公司资金 员工工资 办公场地 设备采购 商业合同 品牌合作 产品研发 电商业务
